newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Monday, analysts said.
The Fed faces an average daily add need of about $9 billion in the remaining few days of the reserve period, analysts predicted.

"Thursday's 14-day fixed system RP is outstanding," noted James Blumenthal, money market economist at MCM MoneyWatch. "But the Fed did not try to finish add job with the operation and more system RPs are needed Monday to Wednesday."
Federal funds opened at 5-7/16 percent but have risen to 5-5/8 percent.

Analysts noted that the tight funds rate was due, in part, to Monday being the day quarterly estimated corporate taxes are due. Others said funds were being pressured by the perception that the Fed is behind on its add job.
